title: arenaria fasciculata subsp. funkii
intro: Arenaria fasciculata subsp. funkii, commonly known as Sea Sandwort, is a plant species native to the coastal regions of Europe, Asia, and North Africa. Sea Sandwort has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites. These constituents may contribute to the plant's antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a potential candidate for further research in the development of natural therapeutic agents.
